'''Nurse Joy's Comfey''' (Japanese: '''ジョーイのキュワワー''' ''Joy's Cuwawa'') are {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Nurse Joy]]s in the [[Alola]] [[region]] alongside {{TP|Nurse Joy|Blissey}}.

==History==
===''Pokémon the Series''===
===={{aniseries|SM}}====
Comfey debuted in ''[[SM004|First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!]]'', where it put its lei around {{Ash}}'s neck soon after Ash first came into contact with it. It also assisted Nurse Joy in treating {{AP|Pikachu}}.

In ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'', Comfey assisted Ash and {{ashcl}} when they were on work experience at the [[Pokémon Center]]. Multiple Comfey appeared during the [[Poké Problem]] extra scene, where they assisted the [[Akala Island]] Nurse Joy in returning to her main island.

Comfey reappeared again in ''[[SM102|Alola, Alola!]]'', where it was seen assisting Nurse Joy in treating a {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s {{p|Yungoos}}.

In ''[[SM103|Heart of Fire! Heart of Stone!]]'', Nurse Joy was revealed to have given {{an|Brock}} one of her {{TP|Brock|Comfey}} as a way of thanking him for helping her in the previous episode.

==={{aniseries|HZ}}===
A Comfey appeared in a fantasy in ''[[HZ003|For Sure! 'Cause Sprigatito's with Me!]]''.

==Personality and characteristics==
Like most of Nurse Joy's Pokémon, Comfey is a helpful and caring Pokémon and is always ready to help injured or sick Pokémon. As shown in ''[[SM004|First Catch in Alola, Ketchum-Style!]]'', it had no problem sharing its lei with Ash, which soothed the Trainer with its aroma.

Comfey is shown to be concerned for Nurse Joy, as seen in ''[[SM068|Real Life...Inquire Within!]]'' where it tried to help her get better when she became ill.
